titles.title: Withholding Nothing / I Give Myself Away

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
I surrender all to You
Everything I give to You

verse.name: c2a
verse.lines:
I give myself away
I give myself away
So You can use me

verse.name: c2b
verse.lines:
My life is not my own
To You I belong
I give myself, I give myself away
